toolkit_control_objective: A board-approved AI policy defines principles, roles and accountability for every AI system.
typical_evidence: Approved AI policy; RACI; committee charter and minutes

toolkit_control_objective: A complete register of AI systems and agents is maintained with owner, tier and status.
typical_evidence: AI register; quarterly completeness review

toolkit_control_objective: Each use case is classified against prohibited, high-risk and other categories using a documented method.
eu_ai_act_2024_1689: Art. 5; Art. 6 (incl. 6(3) derogation, profiling always high-risk); Annex III
typical_evidence: Completed questionnaire; tier rationale; Legal confirmation

toolkit_control_objective: AI-specific risks are identified, assessed, treated and accepted by an accountable owner.
typical_evidence: Risk register; treatment plan; risk acceptance sign-off

toolkit_control_objective: Impact on individuals, groups and society is assessed before deployment and refreshed on change.
eu_ai_act_2024_1689: Art. 27 (FRIA: public bodies, private entities providing public services, and deployers of credit-scoring / life and health insurance systems); Art. 9
typical_evidence: Completed impact assessment; DPIA; review minutes

toolkit_control_objective: Data used for training, grounding and prompts is fit for purpose, representative, minimised and lawfully sourced.
india_dpdpa_2023: s.8(3) (completeness, accuracy, consistency); s.8(7); s.9 (children's data)
typical_evidence: Data lineage; data quality report; minimisation decision

toolkit_control_objective: Personal data use has a documented lawful basis / consent and a clear notice.
india_dpdpa_2023: s.4; s.5; s.6; s.7; s.9 (verifiable parental consent; no tracking, behavioural monitoring or targeted advertising directed at children)
typical_evidence: Lawful-basis record; privacy notice; consent logs

toolkit_control_objective: Users and affected people are told when they interact with AI or receive AI-generated content, with meaningful information on use and limits.
typical_evidence: User-facing disclosures; instructions for use; model card

toolkit_control_objective: Effective human oversight is designed in, with competence, authority and ability to override.
typical_evidence: Oversight design; override test results; oversight effectiveness metrics (override rate, review time, reviewer miss rate); operator training records

toolkit_control_objective: The system is verified and validated for accuracy and robustness against defined metrics before release.
typical_evidence: Test plan and results; acceptance thresholds; evaluation reports

toolkit_control_objective: Bias risks are examined and mitigated, with fairness metrics appropriate to the context.
typical_evidence: Bias testing report; mitigation log; protected-attribute analysis

toolkit_control_objective: AI systems, models, prompts, keys and data are protected with least privilege and secure engineering.
typical_evidence: Security review; access matrix; pen-test / red-team report

toolkit_control_objective: Events, inputs, outputs and decisions are logged to support traceability, investigation and audit.
india_dpdpa_2023: Supports s.8(1) and s.8(5); Rules require retaining processing logs and related records for at least one year (verify current Rules)
typical_evidence: Log schema; retention config; sample audit trail

toolkit_control_objective: Design, data, testing, limitations and intended use are documented and kept current.
typical_evidence: Technical file; model card; architecture diagrams

toolkit_control_objective: Vendors and model providers are assessed, contracted and monitored for AI-specific risk.
eu_ai_act_2024_1689: Art. 25 (value chain); Arts. 51-55 (GPAI providers; Art. 53 information and documentation for downstream providers)
typical_evidence: Vendor assessment (incl. section 6 ongoing monitoring); DPA / contract clauses; SLA and audit rights; GPAI provider documentation and code-of-practice status; model-change notice log

toolkit_control_objective: Changes to models, prompts, tools and data pass change control and trigger re-assessment where material.
typical_evidence: Change tickets; regression results; completed significant-change checklist; re-tiering decision

toolkit_control_objective: Performance, drift, misuse and complaints are monitored with thresholds and escalation.
typical_evidence: Approved monitoring plan; monitoring dashboard; alert rules; monthly or quarterly review minutes

toolkit_control_objective: AI incidents are detected, triaged, contained, reported and learned from.
india_dpdpa_2023: s.8(6); Rule 7 (initial intimation without delay; detailed report to the Board within 72 hours, extendable by the Board)
typical_evidence: Incident playbook; incident log; post-incident reviews; regulator notification records (incl. CERT-In where applicable)

toolkit_control_objective: Affected people can obtain explanation, contest decisions and have complaints handled.
typical_evidence: Complaint procedure; SLA; sample case files

toolkit_control_objective: Staff who build, approve or use AI have training appropriate to role and risk.
typical_evidence: Training curriculum; completion records

toolkit_control_objective: Agents operate within defined autonomy levels, allow-listed tools, least privilege and tested kill switches. (Toolkit extension for agentic AI.)
typical_evidence: Agent register; permission matrix; kill-switch test record; red-team report

toolkit_control_objective: Internal audit and management review test the AI management system and drive improvement.
typical_evidence: Audit plan and reports; management review minutes; corrective actions

toolkit_control_objective: Systems are retired safely, with data, models and documentation handled per retention and erasure rules.
typical_evidence: Retirement checklist; data deletion certificate; archive record

toolkit_control_objective: AI-generated or manipulated content is disclosed or marked where required, and misuse risks are controlled.
typical_evidence: Labelling design; watermark/metadata approach; disclosure text; G2 disclosure and labelling evidence

toolkit_control_objective: Transfers of personal data (including prompts and logs sent to external model providers) are identified, assessed and lawful.
india_dpdpa_2023: s.16 (restrictions via Central Government notification; check sector localisation rules)
typical_evidence: Transfer register; completed transfer assessment (impact assessment section 4A); provider region and data-use terms; sector-regulator localisation check

toolkit_control_objective: Training, grounding and prompt data, models and generated outputs are used within licence and IP terms; ownership of outputs is understood.
eu_ai_act_2024_1689: Art. 53(1)(c)(d) (GPAI providers: copyright policy, training-content summary)
typical_evidence: Data and model licence register; vendor IP indemnity terms; output-use guidance
